title: Deep learning model accurately classifies metastatic tumors from primary tumors based on mutational signatures
summary: MetaWise uses mutational-signature features from tumor sequencing to classify metastatic versus primary tumors across large and external cohorts; this is a specific genomic classification result with limited paired-tumor validation.
ai_technology: Methods use a deep neural network on WES/WGS mutational signatures and compare with conventional and deep-learning baselines.

evidence.tested: MetaWise uses mutational-signature features from tumor sequencing to classify metastatic versus primary tumors across large and external cohorts; this is a specific genomic classification result with limited paired-tumor validation.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the reported dataset, experimental setting and validation in this study; broader generalization and real-world benefit are not established.
